newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL palm oil ends up, spot/nearby futures active.
newsitem.headline: KL palm oil ends up, spot/nearby futures active.

text.p: PALM OIL FUTURES PALM OIL PHYSICAL

PALM OIL FUTURES - Prices ended firmer, with interest seen mostly among spot and nearby futures contracts. Switching activities were also seen in Jan and Feb futures. Underlying firm fundamentals also firmed the market. March futures support at 1,245 and resistance at 1,265.
PALM OIL PHYSICAL - The market moved in tandem with futures. Market awaits forecaster Ivan Wong crop report on Tuesday.
January and February futures closed up 13 ringgit each at 1,273 and 1,270 ringgit respectively.
Traders said the market was still supported by export data for December released by SGS and Caleb Brett last week.
Cargo surveyor SGS estimated exports in December at 717,197 tonnes, while Caleb Brett said it was about 702,082 tonnes.
In November, Malaysia's palm oil exports were 632,441 tonnes, according to the official Palm Oil Registration and Licensing Authority (PORLA).
Traders had estimated output in December to fall by up to 18 percent over the previous month, and also expected a lower end-December stock level of below 900,000 tonnes.
Among physical, Jan (south) saw offers at 1,310 ringgit against bids at 1,300, after trading from 1,295 to 1,300.

Jan (north) was offered at 1,295 and bids at 1,290. Feb (south) saw offers at 1,285 with bids at 1,277.50 with earlier trades at 1,265 and 1,275. Feb (central) was offered at 1,310 against bids at 1,300.
Among refined products, Jan RBD palm oil was offered at $542.50 a tonne FOB Malaysia and Feb/Mar at $540. Jan was traded at $537.50.
Jan RBD palm olein saw offers at $575, Feb at $572.50 and Mar at $567.50. Jan was traded at $570 and $572.50, and Feb at $570.
Jan RBD palm stearin was offered at $412.50 and Feb at $415. Jan/Feb palm fatty acid distillate saw sellers at $295.
